ghia-burgundy.$description: Ghia Burgundy — Primary brand color, header bar, statement sections, marquee bands, footer — the deep wine that grounds the whole system

coral-cta.$description: Coral CTA — Filled pill buttons (Shop Bestsellers, Add to Cart, Our Story), active tab indicators, small accent dots

aperitivo-cream.$description: Aperitivo Cream — Primary page canvas and warm card surfaces

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Lightest surface, header text on dark, soft secondary card backgrounds

smoke-gray.$description: Smoke Gray — Hairline borders, dividers, subtle structural separators

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Icons, fine details, logo strokes on light surfaces

olive-grove.$description: Olive Grove — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

dusty-rose.$description: Dusty Rose — Soft accent border, tag backgrounds, muted product label echo

riviera-blue.$description: Riviera Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

limoncello-yellow.$description: Limoncello Yellow — Highlight tags, sticker accents, energetic punctuation — the spark of citrus in the system

sage-mist.$description: Sage Mist — Muted surface accent, cool-toned badge or chip background

vivey-22-positive.$description: Primary text face — body copy, nav links, buttons, product cards, footer. The humanist serif carries warmth and editorial feel; its italic-influenced curves feel handwritten and aperitivo-friendly rather than corporate.

fha-condensed-french-nc.$description: Display headlines, section titles, large statements — always set in all-caps with tight leading. The condensed proportions create editorial authority and reference classic spirits-label typography.
